domains.name: Physical Disabilities
domains.summary: Specifies physical or orthopedic disabilities and sensory impairments.

domains.name: Substance Abuse History
domains.summary: Indicates caregiver's history of substance abuse.

domains.name: Prior Child Deaths
domains.summary: Records types and numbers of prior child deaths due to various causes.

domains.name: Caregiver Background
domains.summary: Includes caregiver's education, employment status, language proficiency, ethnicity, immigration status, income level, and military service.

domains.name: Violence History
domains.summary: Documents history of intimate partner violence involving the caregiver as perpetrator or victim.

domains.name: Child Maltreatment History
domains.summary: Indicates whether the caregiver has a history of child maltreatment as either a perpetrator or victim, specifying types of abuse and involvement with social services.

domains.name: Received Social Services
domains.summary: Identifies if the caregiver received various forms of social services support.

domains.name: Cognitive and Mental Health Conditions
domains.summary: Specifies cognitive, intellectual, mental health, and substance abuse conditions.
